rationale: Cyclone surge depolarises VH ≥ 3 dB more than agronomic flooding (Voigt et al. 2007; UN-SPIDER 2019).
Smooth surge water reflects specularly → low VV.
Surge collapses cross-pol harder than co-pol (CR drops); agronomic shallow flooding inverts.
Cyclone-flooded pixels are by construction normally-dry land (JRC long-term occurrence low).
